description: A shell script for testing bounds-checking of access to mmapped on-disk file formats, involving packfile and index manipulation, corruption testing, and verification routines.

methods.name: clear_base
methods.description: Removes the base pack and restores the environment after tests.

methods.name: restore_base
methods.description: Restores the original pack files from backup.

methods.name: do_pack
methods.description: Creates a pack file from specified objects, handling packing and naming.

methods.name: munge
methods.description: Corrupts or modifies the pack or index files at specific offsets.

methods.name: ofs_table
methods.description: Calculates offset in a v2 .idx to initial offset table.

methods.name: extended_table
methods.description: Calculates offset in a v2 .idx to extended offset table.
